def forward(groups):
    date_part = groups[0]
    time_part = groups[1]
    millis = groups[2]
    dt = datetime.strptime(f'{date_part} {time_part}', '%Y%m%d %H:%M:%S')
    timestamp = int(dt.timestamp() * 1000) + int(millis)
    return {'stored': [timestamp], 'layout': []}

def inverse(record):
    timestamp = int(record['stored'][0])
    millis = timestamp % 1000
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp // 1000)
    return f'{dt.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H:%M:%S")}:{millis:03}'
